card.name: Linking words before example or comparison lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "such", "the" and "or" that sit right before a named example or a contrasting group, as in "such as" or "compared to the". Also fires partway through "atypical" before antipsychotics.

modes.label: "such" before "as" examples
modes.description: The word "such" opens a list of examples introduced by "such as".
modes.example: those who lived through<< such>> dark moments as the Holocaust, the Depression

modes.label: Contrast or pairing words
modes.description: "the" or "or" comes before a second item in a comparison or a pair of enzymes or drugs.
modes.example: a COX-2 inhibitor, celecoxib, compared to<< the>> non-selective NSAIDs naproxen

modes.label: Inside "atypical antipsychotics"
modes.description: Partway through the word "atypical" or "antipsychotics" when naming this drug class.
modes.example: in patients treated with the at<<ypical>> antipsychotics.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model for a named example or counterpart class to follow.
card.plain: It marks small linking words that lead into a list of examples or a comparison group.
